encode_bboxes_to_distances: encode ground truth bounding boxes into top, bottom, left, right distances from anchor points
decode_distances_to_bboxes: decode predicted distances from anchor points back into bounding box coordinates
create_coder_with_clip: create a DistancePointBBoxCoder instance with clip_border enabled to clip boxes outside image borders
create_coder_without_clip: create a DistancePointBBoxCoder instance with clip_border disabled to allow boxes beyond image borders
review_coder_implementation: review the DistancePointBBoxCoder class and its encode and decode methods for correctness
